Strong players beware. This tuner is sufficient for tuning your A string ONLY. Be aware that - after much testing - I have discovered that NONE of the temperament settings (ie: Violin family, Just, Pythagorean, nor obviously Equal) will show correct readings for the E, D, G, or C strings. 

As a workaround, you can turn ON the “display frequency” option and tune to the correct frequency (E:660, D:293.33, G:195.56, etc). The dial won’t look right, but at least you can get precisely in tune. 

Or you can do what most professionals do: tune to the A (use Equal temperament setting), then turn off the tuner and tune the other strings by ear.

Great tuner - ruined by the update!. As a replacement for my discontinued Korg tuners, this app has it all and then some. It produces a harmonically rich tone (far more useful for tuning pipe organs, which is what I use if for, than the sine wave some PC programs use) over a very wide range, can be set to various temperaments (including user-programmable ones) and is easy to calibrate. The earlier review complaining about calibration difficulties for organ tuning is just flat wrong. It does require you to calibrate on A if you want to do it audibly, otherwise there is some guess work involved, but that was the case with the Korg AT12 as well. I prefer to tune to a reference tone so I've only made limited use of the meter function - it's not as visually striking as a strobe display but it's perfectly adequate. The recent update to "pitch pipe" mode allowing you to chose notes by tapping the note name rather than spinning the virtual wheel really sealed the deal for me. I've been using Cleartune regularly throughout the holiday tuning season with entirely satisfactory results. 

On second thought...

The recent update, while welcome even if way overdue, has eliminated some very significant features. At least on iPhone the note wheel is way too large and the tap to advance function is gone (pipe organs are often laid out in whole tones so these two features rule out "eyes free" operation). Also, the pitch unlock button is gone and so is the listen to calibrate option. I'd almost given up hope of continuing support for this app, but this update is almost worse than just letting it die. Very disappointing.

2. The pitch pipe used to have a lock setting so that you could set it to any pitch and listen to what it sounds like in or out of tune. Please bring that lock setting back so the pitch pipe works exactly as it did before.

James Taylor, in order to accommodate the vagaries of acoustic guitars, tunes his strings flatter than normal. Here is his guide:
High E string -3 cents
B string -6 cents
G string -4 cents
D string -8 cents
A string -10 cents

Best tuner I've ever used.. And that includes standalone units. And I when I say 'best', I do not mean it is the tuner with the most features (though this one does have tons of features), but simplest and easy to use.

Also functions as a pitch pipe, playing any note.
Execellent. Simple, easy-to-use and accurate

Fantastic! Really useful :D. I find that this tuner is very accurate for my trumpet, and the options make it very easy to switch from tuning my trumpet, to tuning my bass for jazz band. Or my guitar when I'm at home. It has plenty of other options I should know how to use, but I really don't, know... Tons of useful stuff for anyone who does know though!!!
Os7-ipad mini-no go. Doesn't appear to work on ipad mini with os7. Really used to love this app.

Doesn't work on iPhone 5?. Ever since I got
My new iPhone this app hAsnt worked At all...
Stopped working on iPhone 5. Doesn't detect the notes since the new ios 7.0.2 update
Does not work on iPhone 5S. I deleted and reinstalled and the app does not work on the 5S. It worked fine on the 5.
The only iOS Tuber I would ever use.. This as been my go to app since it's release. I always look for better tuners and haven't found a better one.

A great tuner. I have had no problems with the tuner, and our band director used it for about 3 years until he wanted a more feature-filled app. (I don't blame him considering that he used his phone to tune, record, and act as a metronome.)

As a bassist, sometimes it's hard for me to tell when I'm out of tune, especially on the E string. I have always gotten it down to a T when tuning using this.

For guitar and bass players (maybe all string instruments?), my other strings tend to ring out when I tune, and that causes the app to spin pretty badly. As long as all my other strings are muted, it works fine.

For those rating it very lowly because it's not working: Have you tried using another person's phone/iPod? I watched a friend of mine use this to tune a piano and his trumpet.
Does not work in iOS 7. Ever since I updated to iOS 7 this app does not work. I really liked it was my primary tuner before that. So I'm very disappointed.

Best tuner!!!!. This is the best tuner i've used! Customer service is great also! I used to use the Boss pedal chromatic tuner, excellent also, but now i'll sell it because this tuner is vert precise too. With the iRig, i need nothing more.

Love this tuner. I have two tuners that I just bought this one and a 30$ tuner for my guitar. Well after using both I haven't touched my 30$ tuner, I use this for every instrument I own guitar, trumpet, trombone, and tuba and I never plan to look back if you need a tuner this is a great app that I would advise over many store bought tuners. Plus this is equipped with your phone so it's just one less item to carry around with all your band equipment. So all in all I advise this app very precise and usefulo

Get this. This is the best tuning app I have ever used, I bought many before clear tune. It can be super simple or very complex depending on what you need, full customization of temperament which is a big deal for major musicians
Great tuner and price!. Very accurate and responsive. Worth paying for.
Excellence was expected... and that's what this tuner delivered! It's always with me, the best.. +++++++

Hooray!. Finally, a tuner app that works for classical musicians! So many of the most popular tuner applications are for guitarists, so it was really refreshing to find this one. I love the ability to choose key and notation system and adjust the calibration of the tuning pitch. All though I don't do much historical performance, those who do will appreciate the wide array of different temperaments to choose from. The only thing I wish this app had was a better background noise dampener for use during orchestra warm up.

Best tuner app!. I use a number of electronic guitar tuners and have tried many guitar tuner apps. This one is the best. The app is very easy to use and tuning is very precise. My guitars sound better when I use this tuner. Highly recommended!!
Love it. I found this to be pretty handy. I like to turn the tone generator up to about 14k where I can't hear it, but it drives the young whippersnappers crazy.

Awesome. This app is fantastic. I easily tuned my piano with this Tuner.
I love it.
I highly recommend it.

Cleartune🎻🎼🎶. Okay for tuning the open strings on my violin, although it is not able to tune my open E spring. Half of the regular notes are incorrectly tuned, especially third finger and sometimes second finger. Not impressed.

reviews.text: Worth Every Penny. I lost my guitar tuner so I got this app until I found it or got a new one. I was very pleasantly surprised with the quality of this tuner and now I'll never go back!

Amazing!. This app I could go on and on about how good this app is for tuning. I am a violinist and this app helps tune to the finest sound you can make on you instrument. When I want to tune to a certain string I can lock it onto a certain string and and look at the top of the screen to tune it perfectly. This is a great app and is better than all of my handheld tuners combined!
Awesome!. Just what I wanted. I have several stringed instruments that have various non-guitar tuning. This tuner is perfect.

Cleartune. From the gauge, I would guess this is more precise than a standard chromatic tuner, but I haven't tested them side by side. Very convenient for travel.

- iPhone 4s running iOS 6.1.3
Great app. Accurate. Simple. Fantastic.

THE BEST TUNER!!!. Anyone needing a REALLY good tuner needed look no further!! This one has all the functions and options required to tune any instrument with speed and great accuracy. I've been using the app for about 2-years and figured I should this app the kudos it has earned in real world use!!
Awesome ^_^. Easy to tune!
No flip. Great tuner, but still won't flip over when I put the mic up to 'hear' my horn clearly. Have to read it upside down. Used to flip over fine. Now it won't.
Fantastic tuner. Best tuner I own.... hands down! Get it!

Works great!. This app is a life saver. It is extremely accurate. We have several tuners lying around but I always reach for my phone. I have tuned every guitar I own from acoustics to bass guitars and never had a problem with a note registering.

I plug the guitar into my phone when tuning. I have used the iPhone built in mic before and it worked fine as well. Those complaining about certain notes or frequencies not picking up can blame the mic not the app. If you are having an issue like this, try moving the soundhole itself closer to the mic.
This is a great tuner!. Totally worth the money!!

My favorite app. I've used this app since it was first released. I've had many guitar tuners over the years (from cheap ones to very expensive ones)...but this is by far my favorite! Definitely recommend!
Great app! Very stable and easy to use. Great app! Very stable and easy to use! Highly recommended! Thank you.

Thank you!. I am a string teacher and I use this app daily to tune my students. Only flaw is that it can not read an open E string on the double bass (both iPhone and iPad editions), but it works when I play the harmonic. My students think its the coolest thing ever. :)

reviews.text: Great app. Very cool, works great and worth 4 bucks, just as useful as my flashlight app but will use it way more-
Good App. Works great and is very handy

Doesn't work properly!!. This tuner is worthless...it will not properly tune the G string on an acoustic guitar. I don't understand how it is properly calibrated for all other strings, but not the G string. I've played guitar for over 20 yrs, and I want to like this tuner, but it simply doesn't work properly. How do its makers not know about this flaw?
Great app.... Love it for my sax & trumpet.
Best tuner app ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!!. Really good tuner its really precise
Great. This app is great for my clarinet my band teacher likes it too
Best tuner out there. I spent a long time looking and this is the best.

Better than my $100 tuner. I use this app for my 47 string harp, it's so much better than my Korg tuner. This has changed my life!!! Ok, maybe it hasn't changed my life, but it is indispensable. I love it.
Very impressed. Got to a gig without a tuner available ....downloaded this lickety split and wow! I just sat it on top of my bass amp. Perfect for my needs.

A Wonderful Tuner App. What a great app! It is precise when checked against my tuning fork. I use it for guitar and sax. Other brass and woodwind bandmates have appreciated me having it on hand when we argue about who is the one out of tune. Highly recommended!!
Perfect. Best tuner I've tried on the App Store and I've tried several. It's actually a better tuner than buying a totally separate electronic tuner at a music store. Nice app.
Supports multiple temperaments. I play a Baroque instrument and it is great having werckmeister as an option.

Precise.. probably the best portable yuner i've found for trumpet. Very precise. Different tuning options which is great if working with strings, etc. 
Since the recent upgrade, the screen is not rotating. 5stars because i'm counting on that getting fixed.

Don't like it.. I have had this app since I first got my iPhone, maybe 4 yrs ago. I have never been able to get it to work reliably. The only reason why I don't delete it is because I paid for it, but this is about to change. This tuner is either so fussy that you can't get a good reading or it fails to function at all. I'll stick with my Korg.

No better than a free one. Won't tune pianos or accordions, because it can't even figure out which of the lower notes are being played. 

Just get a free tuner instead, since the instruments that use the fancy temperaments this tuner features can't be tuned with it. 

Works fine with guitars etc, but so do free tuners. 

I imagine that the limitation has to do with the device hardware.

reviews.text: Essential. The best and most accurate tuner for any instrument and tuning temperament. My most used app as a music teacher!
Too basic. Works but is a bit basic. Only point for me to use an app like this would be to have open tuning presets and such which this app does not offer. I'll stick to my Korg Digital Tuner for now
Great. I just brought it, I got my acoustic yesterday and it works great. I had to tune it some and now it is on fire!! It sounds great get it even if ur a beginner or a experience I use this a lot..
Excellent. More accurate than my dedicated tuner. Very impressive.
Check your bill. Good tuner... Was charged $3.99 for the free version. Not a very upfront way to do business. Not accusing anyone of Dishonesty or False Advertising... Just sayin watch your bill!!

Best Tuner I've Found. Hands down, the best digital tuner I've ever used. Looks good, simple, easy to read, with a phenomenal sample rate..plus more options than you probably know what to do with. I love how I can even tune in non-even temperament. This app is more accurate and reliable than some $20 stand-alone tuners. Well worth the price, especially since you always have your phone on you. Looks even better on the iPad. Good job, developers. Thank you. :)
The best. I've tried several of these and this is, hands down, the best option out there in terms of ease of interface and sensitivity.

Great visual and aural ear training aid. Use this and the iPad version.

iPad Great for tuning up big bands the trumpets can see the green mark easily from the back row.

Great with an iRig. This tuner works great with the phones built in mic on an acoustic guitar. It works ok on an unplugged electric if you hold it really close to the strings, but for electric it really shines when connected through an iRig(I'm sure other similar adapters work fine too).

I've used this on iPhone 4, iPad 2, and iPhone 5. My main use is still on my old iPhone 4 which I keep around as a beater for just this type of use. I'm guessing this would have worked fine on my 3G while I still had it if I hadn't killed its usefulness by installing iOS 4 on it which slowed it to a crawl.
